exact_statement: For every essential prime sign gate of arity 2,3,4 at every product law with each input probability in {1/4,1/2,3/4}, the exact maximum corrected Hplus/(I-Var) is 26-12log2(3), attained by sign OR2 at (1/4,1/4). The complete certificate covers 458356 symmetry representatives of 4639338 labeled gate/bias cases. For the essential prime sign majority3 at probabilities (1-q^3,q,q), the ratio tends to 2+4/ln(2) as q decreases to zero; at q=1/8 it exceeds 73411827299/10000000000>7. Thus an all-interior-bias corrected constant 7 for nonbinary primes of arities 3 or 4 is false. No all-bias supremum, divergent family, or full FEI result is asserted.
